## Common Questions

**Q: How often should I have my AC system serviced in Florida?**
A: We recommend professional AC maintenance twice yearly in Southwest Florida—before cooling season (May) and before any potential winter use (November). Our humid, salty climate accelerates wear, and regular service prevents costly breakdowns during peak heat.

**Q: What should I do if my air conditioner stops working during the hot season?**
A: Call us immediately for 24/7 emergency service. We offer same-day diagnosis and repair for most systems. In the meantime, close blinds, turn off heat-generating appliances, and stay in the coolest room until we arrive.

**Q: Why is my electric bill so high during summer months?**
A: Naples heat and humidity make AC systems work harder. A tune-up can improve efficiency by 5-15%. We'll check refrigerant levels, clean coils, and ensure your system isn't running longer than necessary—often saving hundreds on energy bills.

**Q: How long do air conditioning systems typically last in Florida?**
A: With proper maintenance, most AC systems last 12-15 years in our climate. Salt air and continuous cooling demand can shorten this. We'll assess your system's condition and help you plan for replacement before failure.

**Q: What's included in your preventive maintenance plans?**
A: Our plans include seasonal inspections, coil cleaning, refrigerant checks, filter changes, electrical connection testing, and priority service. Regular maintenance prevents 80% of AC emergencies and extends system life significantly.

## About El Dorado Heating & Cooling

El Dorado Heating & Cooling LLC is a family-owned and operated HVAC company bringing over 60 years of combined experience to the Naples, Bonita Springs, and Marco Island communities. We pride ourselves on delivering the golden standard of customer service, understanding that your home's comfort is a top priority.

Our comprehensive services span the full spectrum of HVAC solutions, including air conditioning and heating repair, system installation, routine maintenance, ductwork services, coil cleaning, and air purification. We also specialize in advanced solutions such as dehumidification and specialty cooling applications, including wine-cellar cooling. Additionally, we provide refrigeration services to meet diverse cooling needs.

Available around the clock for emergency service, El Dorado Heating & Cooling is committed to keeping your home comfortable year-round. We proudly serve our community in both English and Spanish, ensuring accessible, professional service for all customers.
